|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Frostbite (V)]]; it is the current text. * '''Original''' ([[Frostbite (V)]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 2 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009): “Deploy on Hoth system if you control two exterior Hoth sites. During your control phase, may retrieve 1 Force for each Hoth site you control with a unique (•) combat vehicle. If opponent controls this system, this Effect lost. While you occupy 1st marker, [Immune to Alter]”.<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock2">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock2.pdf Virtual Block 2 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022152656/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock2.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): the PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 11 January 2013) changed “Deploy on Hoth system” to “Deploy on the Hoth system” (“immune to Alter.” is the card list's spelling of the Immune to Alter icon). PC-E1 text: “Deploy on the Hoth system if you control two exterior Hoth sites. During your control phase, may retrieve 1 Force for each Hoth site you control with a unique () combat vehicle. If opponent controls this system, this Effect lost. While you occupy 1st marker, immune to Alter.”<ref name="cl-1220_123">Players Committee website card list (VBlock2Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064711/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock2Type.html 2012-07-21] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142857/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock2Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive)</ref> The card list drops icons; the icons here are those of the printed slip. Card-list differences are versions (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).
